text:
Alex Chen: FYI PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/2789 is blocked on architecture signoff. RFC linked in the PR (https://redwood.engineering/rfcs/045-routing-fallbacks). Please take a quick look when you have a moment.

Priya Patel: skimmed the PR — main question: if primary model in a route fails, do we fall back to the quantized variant or to a regional replica? not super clear in the config.

Alex Chen: good call. Current plan (per RFC) is: try regional replica same model -> if unavailable, try quantized variant of same model -> then degrade to lower-cost family. PR has a routing_policy example: ```json
{"order": ["region","quantized","fallback_family"], "timeout_ms": 3000}```

Taylor Nguyen: I'll review the RFC details and the PR tonight. If everyone agrees with the policy we can merge in tomorrow's merge window. tagging @Priya @Sam for quick ops view.

Sam Reynolds: is there a hard SLA impact doc for that change? I want to make sure the console metrics and alerts will still trigger correctly if we start using quantized fallbacks automatically.

Alex Chen: metrics change is minimal — we add tag "fallback_reason" to token-level spans. I added a dashboard patch in the PR description. Alerts same thresholds, but we can add a separate regression alert if fallback_rate > 10% over 5m.

Priya Patel: +1 on the approach. small nit: can we make the fallback timeout configurable per-route? some low-latency routes may want 1500ms. I can add that tweak as a follow-up commit.

Taylor Nguyen: sounds reasonable. I'll leave detailed comments in the PR. If I can get through the RFC + PR tonight I'll post an LGTM. Otherwise ping me in the morning.

deploy-bot: CI started for PR #2789 — checks: unit, integration, lint.

Alex Chen: thanks. tagging this thread in the PR: please reply in the PR for approvals so the automerge can detect it. Also blocking merge until RFC 'approved-by-arch' label is present.

Priya Patel: once CI passes I'll post an approval assuming the per-route timeout config gets a follow-up PR.

Taylor Nguyen: quick note after reading: one architecture comment re: cache invalidation when switching families — left a comment in the RFC doc. overall LGTM pending that small cache detail.

deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #2789 (unit, lint). integration still running.

Sam Reynolds: thanks — I'll watch the alerts after merge. If fallback_rate spikes we can toggle the policy to prefer region-only.

Alex Chen: great. plan: wait for Taylor LGTM and integration CI -> add 'approved-by-arch' label -> automerge during tomorrow morning window. Thanks all for quick responses.

Taylor Nguyen: LGTM (arch).

Alex Chen: merging once integration finishes and label applied :thumbsup:
